core_obligations: The hypotheses reduce: (3) implies (2) by the henselization lemma and (2) implies (1) by the regularity lemma, so it suffices to treat the case where A -> A^wedge is regular.
Apply Popescu's theorem to the finitely presented solution algebra: get a factorization A -> B -> A^wedge with B smooth over A and elements b_i in B with f_j(b) = 0.

Lift the composed section sigma: B -> A^wedge -> A/I^N through the smooth map B -> Spec A/I^N: the lift-section lemma gives an etale A -> A' with A/I^N isomorphic to A'/I^NA' and an A-algebra map sigma-tilde: B -> A' lifting sigma.
Since (A, I) is henselian the etale map A' -> A has a retraction chi; setting a_i = chi(sigma-tilde(b_i)) gives a solution in A congruent to the given one modulo I^N.
proof_roadmap: Hypothesis reductions; Popescu factorization with the solution inside B; section lifting; henselian retraction.
difficulty_reason: A four-step argument; the substance is the section lifting through B and the henselian retraction, both carried.
